Holiday Party DJ – Frequently Asked Questions

When is Christmas Day in 2026?

Christmas Day in 2026 falls on a Friday, December 25th.

When are most holiday parties typically held?

Most holiday parties take place on any day before December 25th or after the holidays in January.

What areas do you serve for holiday party DJ services?

We serve the San Francisco Bay Area, California, including corporate and company holiday parties.

Do you offer special discounts or promotions for Christmas parties?

Yes, we offer Christmas discounts and special holiday pricing. Contact us for details!

Can you provide DJs for Jewish Hanukkah or other year-end holiday celebrations?

Absolutely! We provide DJs for Jewish Hanukkah and other year-end holiday parties.

How can I book a DJ for my Bay Area Christmas party?

You can book by calling 1-415-350-5474 or submitting your booking request on our website.

What if I need emergency party planning help?

We offer emergency party planning! Call Santa DJ at 415-350-5474 for immediate assistance.

What kind of holiday music do you provide?

We offer a wide range of classic and modern Christmas songs including hits from Mariah Carey, Wham, Jose Feliciano, Frank Sinatra, and many more.

Do you provide music for Christmas Eve specifically?

Yes, we provide traditional Christmas Eve songs such as The First Noel, O Holy Night, O Little Town of Bethlehem, and God Rest Ye Merry Gentlemen.

Are other holiday music styles available?

Yes, we also offer music for Hanukkah, New Year’s Eve (NYE), and worldwide holiday celebrations.

Do you provide DJs for other events besides holiday parties?

Yes, we offer DJ services for weddings, Bar/Bat Mitzvahs, Latin, Indian, Asian Christmas events, karaoke, school dances, reunions, birthdays, anniversaries, and more.

What additional entertainment services do you offer?

We provide photo booths, laser light shows, sound, and lighting equipment for your events.

How can I submit a booking request for my company’s holiday party?

Submit your booking request online through our website or call us directly to discuss your event needs.
